title: Harmless
summary: H'ARMLESS, adjective Not hurtful or injurious; innoxious. Ceremonies are harmless in themselves. 1. Unhurt; undamaged; uninjured; as, to give bond to save another harmless 2. Innocent; not guilty. Who

inlines.v: H'ARMLESS, adjective Not hurtful or injurious; innoxious. Ceremonies are harmless in themselves. 1. Unhurt; undamaged; uninjured; as, to give bond to save another harmless 2. Innocent; not guilty. Who is holy, harmless undefiled, separate from sinners. Hebrews 7:26.
